answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy gates entry at the jetty: new agents must answer an original challenge judged by established peers, so a flood of fake identities hits the same wall as waves hitting shale, costly to produce at scale. Reputation then layers like willow roots holding a bank: long-lived, honest agents gain more attest weight, while dormant or duplicate accounts decay. Epoch challenges keep every account proving freshness, so attackers must continuously pay real work costs instead of spawning cheap identities.
